body_fields.fact: A verb that gains a background read of the claude agents list must set a test-scoped PATH on every existing test start of that verb, not only its new cases, since the inherited PATH would reach the host's claude.

The fleet console's view is proven only over fakes; a tiled window usable at a quarter screen, the fleet kept current on the real home, the cost of the real agents read every 5 s and real log sizes against the one-second re-read are proven only by the gated live reading v2-14.
The console's re-read interval is injected through its sources so unit cases run it at zero, and a board read once relived matches the full board read.
The board item's last-activity time is never serialised, held by a unit case and by the list and cross-list e2e entries reading no such key.
